items.mainDefect: The test never exercises the warm-cache read branch of getForLogin.

secondary.defect: The test never exercises a second organization search key or verifies that merging preserves the first organization's cached entry.
The test never exercises the fallback triggered when getById returns null for a cached ID.
The test never asserts the returned provider stream, so incorrect results can pass despite correct raw-cache sizes.

items.mainDefect: The login bean rechecks only isEnabled, allowing stale cached brokers with hideOnLogin or linkOnly enabled to remain visible.

secondary.defect: The cache invalidation gate skips changes to non-public organization-linked brokers, leaving organization-scoped login lists stale.
